text:
incident-bot: PAGED: latency spike on /v1/chat (p99 > 1200ms) — affected routes: chat-completions, chat-streaming. Pager: oncall (Anna D.).
Anna D.: seeing it, joining now. ETA to look 2m.
Mike G.: confirming alerts firing from multiple regions, seems concentrated on maas-east1 GPU pool. p95 is elevated but p99 is shooting up.
Liam S.: any recent rollouts?
Anna D.: no model rollouts in last 6h. Recent infra change: autoscaler tweak applied ~10m ago. rolling back autoscaler is one option.
Mike G.: logs show KV-cache misses spiking for several routes. Possibly cache eviction policy triggered by burst.
Anna D.: mitigation plan: 1) temporarily route low-priority traffic to cheaper model variant (mistral-small) 2) enable per-route squelch on p99 alert to avoid paging for noisy routes while we stabilize 3) open a dashboard with tail-latency histograms. Doing step 1 now.
Anna D.: /run route-switch --from=chat-completions --to=mistral-small --weight=30%  (running)
incident-bot: command acknowledged, rollout started.
Jen K.: I'm updating the alerting config: will introduce a gradual squelch window (5m warm, 20m cool) and a dynamic threshold bump for routes with <100qps to reduce noise.
Mike G.: paste of alert query for audit:
```
query: latency_p99{route=~"/v1/chat.*"} > 1200
group_by: route, model
window: 5m
```
Mike G.: proposed change: add noise_gate: if route_qps < 50 then suppress page, if >50 keep page but escalate to pager after 3 occurrences in 15m.
Liam S.: agree. Also add a per-model fallback policy: if primary model p99 > 1200 and KV-cache-miss-rate > 30% then fallback.
Anna D.: squelch config applied to chat-streaming and chat-completions routes for p99 alert. We will keep an email/ops log so product teams are informed.
Jen K.: creating a short-lived dashboard: tail latency by route/model, KV-cache miss rate, GC pauses, and autoscaler instance churn. Sharing link in a sec.
Jen K.: dashboard link: https://grafana.redwood/ops/d/latency-tail/chat-p99-metrics (internal)
Mike G.: after routing 30% off to small model p99 dropped from ~1400ms -> ~800ms in 10m. Good signal.
Anna D.: next: roll back autoscaler tweak? I think it contributed. Planning rollback to previous policy in 5m if we don't see improvement.
Liam S.: prepared rollback commands. Standby.
Anna D.: rolling back autoscaler now.
incident-bot: AUTOSCALER-ROLLBACK completed by Anna D.
Mike G.: post-rollback p99 steadying ~650-900ms across regions, KV-cache miss back down. Good. Recommend keeping squelch for 2h and track.
Anna D.: setting temporary squelch window to 2h, will create follow-up ticket to review thresholds and create per-route SLOs. Assigning to eng-platform and SRE.
Anna D.: ACTIONS:
- ENG-PLATFORM: create a per-route p95/p99 SLO dashboard + histograms (owner: Jen K.)
- SRE: codify noise_gate rules in alerting repo and add integration tests for <50qps behavior (owner: Mike G.)
- RUNTIME: investigate KV-cache eviction pattern and potential for adaptive cache sizing (owner: Liam S.)
- Product ops: notify customers on reduced latency by fallback where applicable (owner: Anna D.)
Mike G.: I'll open the PR for alert changes with the noise_gate and squelch policy, link will be in channel.
Anna D.: handing off to Mike for the watch window. I'll remain reachable for 30m then hand to next oncall.
Mike G.: ack. I'll monitor dashboards and watch for any re-escalation.
Liam S.: logging notes for postmortem: correlated autoscaler tweak + sudden traffic burst -> cache churn -> p99 tail. Recommend throttling autoscaler changes during peak and adding a canary period.
Anna D.: thanks team. marking incident as mitigated for paging. Keeping channel open for post-incident review and dashboard creation. :white_check_mark:
incident-bot: Incident status updated: mitigated -> monitoring.
Anna D.: last update before handoff: p99 stable <900ms, no pages in last 12m. handing to Mike G. for watch.
Mike G.: taking over. I'll escalate if things regress.
Anna D.: handing off complete.
Mike G.: noted. adding timeline and summary to the follow-up ticket.
